title: Fix Agent Chat 'chat drives the stage' e2e oracle: stub re-emits tool call every step → 24 rects, asserts 1 (FAILS)
description:
The P4 capstone oracle (apps/desktop/e2e/agent-chat-drives-stage.spec.ts, commit 0633c33, task 1279) FAILS reproducibly. The commit message claims 'the new Playwright spec passes' — it does not.

ROOT CAUSE (packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/testStub.ts): makeStubRunTurn builds a MockLanguageModelV3 whose doStream UNCONDITIONALLY emits the scripted stage_add_shape tool call on EVERY invocation. The AI SDK streamText multi-step loop re-invokes doStream once per step and only stops at stopWhen: stepCountIs(MAX_STEPS=24). So the stub emits a tool call on all 24 steps, dispatchAgentCommand('stage_add_shape') runs 24 times, and the live document gains 24 rectangles. The spec asserts expect.poll(countShapes).toBe(before+1) → FAILS with 'Expected: 1, Received: 24'. (Also seen: the 15s waitForSelector for the first agent-tool-chip can time out under the 24-step storm — secondary flakiness.)

Verified via diagnostic e2e run: chips=24, errs=0, shapeCount=24. And the real spec: 'Expected: 1 / Received: 24, Timeout 10000ms exceeded while waiting on the predicate' at line 128 (.toBe(before+1)).

IMPORTANT — the underlying feature is SOUND: the chat→tool→stage path genuinely works (all 24 dispatches succeeded via the REAL buildAgentTools/dispatchAgentCommand; only the model is mocked — the right seam). agent-mcp (20/20) and authoring-ui unit tests (760/760) and smoke (3/3) are all green. The bug is purely in the test stub's termination.

FIX: the mock should emit the scripted tool call(s) only on the FIRST doStream call, then on subsequent step(s) return a plain text/stop finish (finishReason:'stop', no tool-call part) so the loop terminates after exactly one tool round. E.g. track a call index in makeStubRunTurn's closure and after the scripted calls are exhausted emit { type:'finish', finishReason:'stop' } with no tool-call. Then countShapes == before+1 holds and the chip-wait is deterministic. Re-run: pnpm --filter @flash/desktop e2e -- agent-chat-drives-stage (must pass).

Found by e2e QA verification of task 1279 at HEAD 0633c33.
